##: Jedi 的 Scoop 清单。本仓库本身就是 bucket（清单放在 bucket/ 目录下）：
也可以不加 bucket，直接从 URL 装一次：
发布新版本后执行 `pnpm scoop:manifest`（CI 里由 .github/workflows/scoop.yml 自动执行）刷新 version/url/hash。
安装方式：Scoop 不跑 NSIS 安装器，而是用 7-Zip 把安装器里打包的程序文件直接解到 $dir——
因此是便携版：不写注册表、不建卸载项、Post-install 才由 Scoop 生成 shim 和开始菜单快捷方式。
description: Local-first developer toolbox: hosts manager, knowledge wallpapers, podcasts, screenshot tool and AI chat.
notes: Jedi is installed as a portable copy: no NSIS installer, no registry entries.
7-Zip is pulled in as a dependency because the program files are unpacked from the official installer.
Run `jedi` in a terminal, or launch it from the Start Menu.
Upgrade with `scoop update jedi`, remove with `scoop uninstall jedi`.
The in-app updater targets the installer/MSI builds - with Scoop, prefer `scoop update jedi`.
